name: siga
description: SIGA: simulator-interface grounding adapter for GEOS XML authoring. R = geos-rag MCP (scripts/geos_rag_mcp.py), X = xmllint MCP (scripts/xmllint_mcp.py), S = validation Stop hook (hooks/hooks.json). M (memory_primer_dsv4_m1u.md) and the primer are system-prompt text; benchmarks/siga-geos/siga_bench/cells.py assembles a paper cell.
